description: Generates an 8,760-hour annual electrical load profile (real MW, reactive MVAR, apparent MVA, and PUE) for a project or location based on climate, cooling system, and workload type. Pass a project name, ID, state, or IT capacity.

include_hourly_sample.description: Whether to include the first 24-hour chronological load sample array.

it_capacity_mw.description: Nameplate IT compute capacity in megawatts (e.g. 100).

load_mw.description: Target IT electrical load in megawatts (e.g. 100).

location.description: City, county, or market location (e.g. 'Abilene, TX', 'Columbus, OH').

power_factor.description: AC power factor at the point of interconnection (default: 0.95).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Project ID, canonical ID, or project name (e.g. 'AXP-US-NY-00593', 'P017').

query.description: Project name, alias, or city/state location (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Dallas, TX').

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

target_mw.description: Alias for target IT capacity in megawatts (e.g. 100).

name: generate_parametric_8760_profile

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.

title: Generate Hourly 8760 Load Profile
